title: RICOCHET answers players in Reddit AMA
body: Activision's head of RICOCHET Anti-Cheat took player questions on r/CallofDuty about enforcement, cheat sellers, aimbots and Ranked Play, including how suspicious accounts get limited matchmaking.

title: Drill Charge nerfed, Joint Fire every Friday
body: The Nov 16 update cuts the Drill Charge's impact damage at range by 75% (close range is unchanged) and makes Joint Fire a 24-hour event every Friday through Season 1. Infinity Ward is also investigating loadouts that reset after Wager Matches and between logins.

title: Flinch cut and range buffs for most guns
body: The Nov 13 update cuts flinch on ARs, SMGs, LMGs and pistols and stretches damage ranges on most guns, with big jumps for the M4, PPSh-41 and Wz.55 Striga. The Patriot XMR loses its mid damage tier and the Mosin-Nagant's max damage range is cut 63%.

title: Hitscan range nearly quadrupled
body: The Nov 11 update gives every ballistic gun a 3.91x hitscan increase, with true hitscan range now about 35 m, and cuts bullet connection time by 34 ms. Long-range ARs benefit most.

title: Veterans Day: C.O.D.E. Valor Pack
body: All net proceeds from the Valor Pack go to the Call of Duty Endowment. A community mission runs until Nov 25: 5 million DAGOR rides unlocks a $25,000 donation.

title: Warzone Season 1 stats: Osprey and VEL 46
body: Day 2 of MW4 in Warzone. With their top builds, the VEL 46 has the fastest SMG TTK at 567 ms (0-10 m, 952 rpm), the Patriot XMR leads the long-range rifles at 558 ms, and the Cronen Osprey runs 612 ms with 900 m/s bullets. The KG-7 Vulcan sniper carries a 2.6x head multiplier.

title: Warzone Season 1 detailed
body: MW4 comes to Warzone on Nov 6 with the new Hajin Battle Royale map, the Zodiac Resurgence map, all 33 MW4 weapons and shared progression. Verdansk and Rebirth Island return later in the season.

title: Season 1 intel revealed
body: Season 1 starts Nov 6 with Backstab, Canyon and a reimagined Shoot House, the X01 DMZ location, the Cronen Osprey and CSG-35, and a 100-tier battle pass for 1,100 CP.

title: Multiplayer is live early
body: Set your Call of Duty account address to New Zealand and Multiplayer opens now on every platform.

title: Modern Warfare 4 launches
body: Full release at midnight local time with 33 weapons, 33 Operators, Multiplayer and DMZ.

title: Shipment arrives
body: The fan-favorite map joins the Core 6v6 rotation a few days after launch.

title: Possession and Infected
body: Two Halloween modes land the week after launch. Infected follows on Oct 30.
